description:
Pro feature. Pull a component together with the files it imports from its own repository,
    so it runs without hunting for helpers: each file with source and licence/attribution header,
    plus a manifest of files, npm/pip packages and install commands. Cost: 3 credits per call (Pro
    plan; other plans get an upgrade message and are not charged).

    Parameters: component_id (required) -- an id from search_components.

    Returns JSON with the files, manifest, licences and credits_charged.

    Example: get_component_bundle(component_id="<id from search_components>")
name: get_component_bundle
title: Get component bundle (Pro)
